'''''A Primer of Real Functions'''''  is a revised edition of a classic [[Carus Monograph]] on the [[theory of functions of a real variable]]. It is authored by [[Ralph P. Boas Jr.]] and the fourth edition updated by his son [[Harold P. Boas]].<ref>{{cite journal |last1=GáL |first1=I. S. |title=Review: R. P. Boas, Jr., A primer of real functions |journal=Bulletin of the American Mathematical Society |date=1962 |volume=68 |issue=1 |pages=10–12 |url=https://projecteuclid.org/euclid.bams/1183524445 |accessdate=28 March 2018 |language=EN |issn=0002-9904 |doi=10.1090/s0002-9904-1962-10672-7 |doi-access=free}}</ref>
